notes.title: Portal is here
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28852020/bc28ce245ba8fc3882c53a1ad580f71770e75f82.png[/img]
By just reading the name of the new game mode, experienced Lines players will probably understand the idea: indicate a place on the grid where a colored line will submerge, and indicate another point where it will emerge.

We're quite happy with the end result and you'll have plenty of levels to enjoy it! With a total of 500 levels (excluding the Steam Workshop levels), you'll be good for hours of game play.

Don't forget that every level has over 200 different variations, so one could say there are over 100.000 levels!

By also adding a bunch of new languages, one could say this is a pretty substantial update. Have fun playing!

notes.title: Fix - Daily repeating
notes.content:
Hi all,

We updated the game again. There was an issue for some players where they got the exact same level every day when playing the Daily challenge. Obviously that should be a different (randomized) level every day. So in theory you could get the same level twice in a row (1 in 250 chance), but every day is a bit much!

Have fun!
Gamious
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28852020/3e42e869c3a02ad6749ebd3b0a887078e1f7459e.png[/img]

notes.title: Two fixes! Save issue resolved.
notes.content:
Hi all,

Thanks for the positive reception and the first levels being uploaded to the workshop. Hopefully there are many more to follow!

[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28852020/3e42e869c3a02ad6749ebd3b0a887078e1f7459e.png][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28852020/871dd1eeddd92ec6bb8dc8d011a17808c7a672a3.png[/img][/url]

In the first week we encountered one issue that needed resolving: Players playing the game for the first time did not always have their progress saved. We're not sure why that happened, but we are now backing up each save locally so that it should not happen again.

Another issue was more a wish by Twitch viewers. They can now hit !score in chat and get their own score back. Instead of just the top 5.

Thanks
Gamious

notes.title: Unknown Pleasures: 10 of the best new Steam games
notes.content:
Welcome back to Unknown Pleasures, our weekly round-up of ten promising but under-reported games from the torrent of new releases on Steam over the past seven days. I play a glut of titles for ten minutes each, discard any rotten ones, then choose which ten make the weekly round-up, as well as picking one stand-out favourite.

This week: myriad monochrome, haunted ice stations, smart shump remixes and the singular glory of painted lines.
… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Lines OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Lines is out TODAY. Enjoy! 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28852020/3e42e869c3a02ad6749ebd3b0a887078e1f7459e.png[/img]

Below is the 'official' statement in the press release:

Gamious’ award-winning puzzle game, Lines, is now available on Steam with lots of additional features specifically for the PC audience. The original already successful on iOS, Lines for PC features 250 levels with countless variations, an extra ‘infinite’ game mode, a higher difficulty setting and a level editor with Steam Workshop integration. 

Feature List [list]

[*]250 levels in the core game. Endless more in the Steam Workshop.
[*]A Level Editor with Steam Workshop integration.
[*]6 game modes: Point, Eraser, Rope, Knife, Mixed and Infinite.
[*]Set a winning streak. Earn medals and achievements.
[*]Play under pressure in the Daily Challenge, in which you only get one chance!
[*]Full Twitch integration.
[*]Fully localized in English, German, Russian, Brazilian Portuguese, Chinese, Italian, Spanish, French and Dutch. [/list]

notes.title: Lines Release tomorrow June 8th!
notes.content:
Hi all, 

Just a quick note. Lines will be released in full tomorrow, June 8th! The game will be available at $4,99/£3,99/€4,99.

If you are a streamer on Twitch, make sure to check out the Twitchplays game mode: http://gamious.com/lines-twitch-mode

Have fun!

notes.title: Lines - Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Hi all,

The Lines Steam store page is now live. Pretty soon we will be releasing the game into the wild. The store description should tell you everything you need to know. If you're interested in the game, [b]wishlist[/b] it now.

Twitch Streamers
The game has full Twitch integration. Meaning that viewers in chat will play the game together with the streamer and can compete with each other. All inside Twitch chat.

Interested in streaming the game on release day? Let us know!
